# Paper E: Echo Graph Report

## e1_scope
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_echo; SECTION_KEY=e1_scope]
Paper Echo Report USES EchoGraph. EchoGraph TARGETS Citation Trace by walking entity relations attached to evidence chunks.

## e2_dataset
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_echo; SECTION_KEY=e2_dataset]
EchoGraph is EVALUATED_ON ScholarToy. ScholarToy is a Dataset of synthetic papers, methods, datasets, tasks, metrics, and concepts.

## e3_metric
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_echo; SECTION_KEY=e3_metric]
EchoGraph REPORTS Graph Path Validity. Graph Path Validity is a Metric requiring every returned relation path to reference existing entities and an evidence chunk.

## e4_concept
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_echo; SECTION_KEY=e4_concept]
EchoGraph USES Graph Expansion. The graph expansion step can recover evidence from a related document when vector search only finds the query entity.

## e5_compare
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_echo; SECTION_KEY=e5_compare]
Paper Echo Report COMPARES_WITH CascadeReader. EchoGraph exposes paths; CascadeReader uses those paths for multi-source answers.
